correctness.rationale: Every (n-1)-letter prefix class requires at least q-1 sensors, since two unselected final-letter siblings are indistinguishable. The checksum has exactly q-1 choices per class. It reports VERIFY_OK cases=4; no infinite-family inference is made.

originality.rationale: The defining 2014 primary paper proves the same universal lower bound but does not attain it at n=2t-1; its construction in Theorem 3.12 has q^t extra vertices, and it expressly calls optimality open. The new stated values use a modular checksum with four exhaustive certifications. The available previously stated results for q=2 at radii 3,4,5 and for radius 2 over q>=3 concern disjoint parameter pairs and do not imply these exact cases. No covering indexed research record or primary-literature claim was located; this is a qualified best-knowledge conclusion, not a uniqueness or priority proof.
